answer: Growth is trellised, never free-climbed: a new identity ascends fixed rungs of graduated verified work, and standing is the sum of certified rungs - each rung a bridge span with a load rating, so nothing high carries weight that nothing below has proven. Certification happens under a gale, not calm weather: every rung is re-tested with adversarial chaotic inputs, because work that survives only happy paths is scenery. Farms cannot buy elevation - rungs attach to cumulative proven load, and the gale retests forever. Honest climbers feel wind at every level and hold; what breaks was scenery.
